projects.title: ChogWorks
projects.description:
ChogWorks turns community participation into shared rewards and gives Chog Genesis NFTs a practical role beyond a profile picture.

Advertisers create funded campaigns for actions on X, Discord, Telegram, or websites. Users complete quests, earn points, and receive a proportional share of the weekly reward pool.

Campaign funds are split into 80% reward escrow, 10% team fees, and 10% sent to a burn address. Only the portion corresponding to completed tasks contributes to rewards; unused escrow can be refunded when the creator closes and settles a campaign.

Chog Genesis holders unlock an upgradeable points miner. Mining and daily check-in bonuses together contribute no more than 20% of a user's quest points to their reward score, keeping completed work at the center of the economy.

Users sign in with Google or email and receive an embedded wallet. CHOG ownership is checked on Monad. Holders can prove control through a small MON transfer to their own embedded wallet, including supported internal transfers, without connecting their NFT wallet to the site.

The MVP includes campaign creation, quest completion, daily streaks, holder verification, mining, upgrades, a weekly leaderboard, campaign settlement and refunds, and smart-contract reward claims.

Current demo:
• Payments and rewards use test $WORK on Robinhood Chain Testnet.
• The planned production token is $CHOG.
• Social profiles are entered manually. Social API verification is not integrated yet; test completions are credited after the Go/Verify cooldown and remain subject to manual spot checks.
• Weekly distributions are published by the admin after settlement; users claim their rewards onchain.
• Transfers to the burn address do not reduce ERC20 totalSupply.

Built for Chogathon as a working testnet MVP.
projects.author: @MLevockin
projects.tech_stack: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vinext, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1, Dynamic embedded wallets, Solidity, OpenZeppelin, ethers.js, Monad, Robinhood Chain Testnet
projects.gtm_plan:
Start with a small pilot in the Chog community, bringing together Chog Genesis holders, active community members, and projects seeking measurable participation.

Recruit initial advertisers from ecosystem projects and community creators. Run limited campaigns, collect user feedback, and measure task completion, advertiser repeat usage, retention, and disputed completions.

Before a production launch, integrate supported social APIs, strengthen account-abuse controls, independently review the contracts, and validate the reward economy with pilot data.

The planned production version will use $CHOG. Advertisers fund campaigns, participants share rewards for completed work, and Chog Genesis holders receive access to the miner. Growth will focus on useful campaigns and repeat advertiser demand.
projects.judge_access:
Open https://chogworks.fun and sign in with Google or email. No invitation is required. An embedded EVM wallet is created during onboarding.

Quests, daily check-in, and the leaderboard can be explored without holding a Chog NFT. The miner requires verified Chog Genesis ownership on Monad and a completed quest for shift activation.

For transaction testing, fund the embedded wallet with test ETH and test $WORK on Robinhood Chain Testnet. The Profile page provides the wallet address and funding links. Users pay their own testnet gas.

To test a campaign:
1. Fund an advertiser account and create a small campaign.
2. Sign in with a second account, add the relevant social handle, press Go, and then Verify after the ten-second cooldown.
3. Check the awarded points and leaderboard.
4. Return to the advertiser account and use Close & refund to settle completed work and recover unused escrow.

Social API checks are not connected in this demo. Weekly reward claims become available after the admin publishes a settled distribution. These limitations are also explained on the website.

The demo video shows the main workflows, including features that require a CHOG holder or admin.

projects.title: Chog Wallet Tracker
projects.description: Chog Wallet Tracker is a real-time NFT alpha tool that follows smart-money wallets onchain and alerts you the moment they mint, accumulate or exit a collection. Access is token-gated for Chog NFT and $CHOG holders on Monad, verified by a simple self-transfer, no signatures or approvals.

projects.title: Chog World — Your Chog, Your Identity
projects.description: Chog World is a mini multiplayer social game inspired by the Chog Genesis NFT collection on Monad. Players enter a shared island as Chog characters, explore the world, chat with others, and interact in real time. Each Chog's unique NFT traits shape its in-game identity, turning digital collectibles into living characters in a shared world.
